_meta.source: Draft Quick Quiz bank. Behavioural questions adapt Banfield's four AI-drafted sample questions; 'coffee' and 'home' come from the Oct 2 / Oct 9 meetings; fit questions follow Banfield's fit criteria. Wording, options and weights must be reviewed by Banfield before use.
_meta.weights: Weights are points toward archetype ids from archetypes.json. 3 = strong signal, 2 = moderate, 1 = light. Indirect questions (coffee) use light weights only.
_meta.fit: Questions with a 'criterion' feed the fit assessment. Their ratings live in fit.json, not here, and they carry no archetype weights.
_meta.contact: Name, email, phone and full site address are collected in a separate required contact step, not in this bank.

questions.prompt: When a big decision lands on your plate, you usually...

options.label: Find someone who knows their stuff and go with their call
Research until I'm confident I understand every option
Talk it through with the people in my life first
Follow the idea that excites me and see where it goes
Map out every step and keep an eye on it myself

questions.prompt: How involved do you want to be in the design process?

options.label: Show me the finished plan. I trust you.
Bring me in at the big moments to riff on ideas
Walk me through the details and the why behind them
Hands on. I want a say in selections, vendors and budget.
Honestly not sure yet. I'd like to learn how it all works.

questions.prompt: We show you a design that's quite different from what you pictured. Your first reaction?

options.label: Great, that's why I hired you

I'd want to compare it side by side with my original idea
A little nervous. I'd rather stay close to what I imagined.
